product_metadata.title: Yamazaki Home Toothbrush Stand-Holder & Organizer for Bathroom, One Size, Blue
features: TOOTHBRUSH STAND: This simply designed bathroom organizer stores toothbrushes to make more space on your sink or countertop. The slim style keeps it out of the way while getting ready for bed.

MODERN DESIGN: The modern look of Yamazaki is meant to match your home decor with a light and airy design. It is made of sleek, ceramic material. Get this essential space saver for easy access throughout the day.
FUNCTIONAL:   This holder stand is easy to clean. Drawers, cabinet shelves, vanities, and counters will stay clutter free while having a compartment for your daily toiletries.
DIMENSIONS: This product is 1. 4 x 4. 3 x 1 inches. The rectangular stand is available in both blue and white. It can hold up to four toothbrushes.

BRAND: Yamazaki brings thought and creativity to everyday items through design inspired by life in Japan. Items are created with special attention to simplicity, practically, quality, and saving space.
description: This sleek toothbrush stand can hold up to four toothbrushes while occupying a minimum of counter space. Available in white or blue.
